svg.title: Dipole radiation and unpolarized Rayleigh phase function
svg.text: Maximum along ±z; half as strong at 90°
Spherical mesh: θ from +z; φ from +x toward +y. r = relative intensity.
(x, y, z) = r (sin θ cos φ, sin θ sin φ, cos θ)
Dark curves: constant θ · light curves: constant φ · same radial scale in (a–c).
